units.source_text: 天色渐昏，彤云密布，即将下雪，暮色十分凄凉。

en.t: The sky gradually darkened, crimson clouds gathered thickly, and snow seemed about to fall; the dusk was deeply desolate.

units.source_text: 来迎接的几位公子催促道：“天气坏得很呢，早点动身吧。”

en.t: The young gentlemen who had come to escort her urged, "The weather is very bad; let us set out early."

units.source_text: 夫人只管揩着眼泪，茫然地沉思着。

en.t: The lady merely kept wiping away her tears, lost in a blank, sorrowful reverie.

units.source_text: 那女公子是髭黑大将所最钟爱的，她想：

en.t: That young lady was the one General Higekuro loved most dearly, and she thought:

units.source_text: “我今后没有了父亲，怎么过日子呢？

en.t: "How am I to live from now on without my father?

units.source_text: 现在不能向他告别，今后恐无再见之缘了！”

en.t: I cannot even say farewell to him now, and I fear I may never have the chance to see him again."

units.source_text: 便俯伏在地，不肯跟母亲走。

en.t: Then she lay face down on the floor and refused to go with her mother.

units.source_text: 夫人抚慰她，对她说道：“你不肯走，使我更加伤心了！”

en.t: The lady comforted her and said, "Your refusing to go makes me even more heartbroken."

units.source_text: 女公子盼望父亲此刻回家，一心等候着。

en.t: The young lady longed for her father to come home at that very moment, and waited for him with all her heart.

units.source_text: 但天色已经如此晚了，髭黑大将岂肯回来呢？

en.t: But with the hour already so late, how could General Higekuro be expected to return?

units.source_text: 女公子平日坐时常倚靠在东面的柱子上，

en.t: When the young lady sat there in ordinary times, she often leaned against the pillar on the eastern side,

units.source_text: 想起这柱子今后将让与别人倚靠，不胜感慨，

en.t: and when she thought that from now on this pillar would be left for someone else to lean against, she was overcome with emotion,

units.source_text: 便将一张桧皮色的纸折叠一下，

en.t: so she took a sheet of cypress-bark-colored paper and folded it once,

units.source_text: 匆匆地在纸上写一首诗，

en.t: hurriedly wrote a poem on the paper,

units.source_text: 用簪端把纸塞进这柱子的裂缝里。

en.t: and used the tip of her hairpin to tuck the paper into a crack in that pillar.
